title: Peer document-infrastructure loss and semantic-evidence boundary
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only plan/test audit; plan-only
scope: Compare current open-source project contracts for DWG/DXF graph preservation, version/direction support, 2D projection, 3D carriers, and consumer qualification.
Use an older peer-reported same-library writer failure only as an adversarial failure shape, not as current implementation status or evidence of a local defect.
Refine existing PAR-20/7G, PAR-49, PAR-122, and PAR-07/S8 acceptance receipts without duplicating already-covered local gates.

sources.revision: Current public pages reviewed 2026-10-20; discussion #479 is an older, unpinned report
sources.observed: Discussion #479 reports a same-library DWG read/write that lost data/infrastructure and had differences in external application visibility and model/paper-space default behavior. The maintainer cited then-unimplemented XRecords and dictionary infrastructure; the discussion does not establish current ACadSharp behavior. The current published matrix is direction-specific and declares AC1021 DWG read but not write, so AC1021 cannot be used as an ACadSharp DWG-writer differential.

The manual separates stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled dynamic classes. It says some unstable data maps to unknown-object/entity placeholders and same-version persistence requires the complete known unknown_bits blob. This is a project support contract, not a DXF/DWG normative rule.

The DXF OGR route projects 3DFACE/SOLID/TRACE into OGR shapes, including degeneracy-based point/line forms; it does not represent ASM solids as OGR geometry. Optional raw ASM data and affine transform fields are documented only for DXF AC1027 and later.

The file-interface documentation preserves SOLID's unusual last-two raw vertex order and distinguishes raw OCS data from corrected SOLID.vertices()/wcs_vertices() results. This is useful for wire-versus-normalized-geometry test design, not a B-rep semantic oracle.

The project documents DWG import as experimental and disabled by default, and states that DWG writing is not implemented. This defines a future opt-in read-consumer lane, not a writer or library support result.

localEvidence: PAR-20/7G generated tests cover object roots, dictionary/XRECORD relationships, owner reciprocity, and graph refusal/retry.
PAR-49 generated tests cover block/layout ownership, member identity, and paper-space layout closure.
PAR-122 and current layout/viewport tests separately model the LAYOUT-to-BLOCK_RECORD link and last-active viewport; this research found no reason to duplicate these local controls.
PAR-07/S8 and generated SOLID/modeler tests distinguish raw carrier data, OCS/WCS transformations, payload identity, and geometry semantics.
The historical PAR-139.1/.2 GEODATA-red snapshot is superseded by the recorded GEODATA newline-escape implementation and current focused selector/owning hardening-gate passes.

validation.result: Both GEODATA selectors pass; owning hardening CTest passes 1/1. These checks validate the stale plan-status correction only; they do not qualify peer interoperability or new support claims.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-20/7G object graph and opaque-record disposition
PAR-49 block/layout identity and owner closure
PAR-07/S8 modeler carrier, transformed geometry, and consumer semantics

planChanges: Make writer self-reopen, complete typed/opaque object disposition, document graph integrity, layout/current-space state, raw wire values, transformed geometry, and external application default-view behavior separate evidence fields.
Require peer capability matching by direction and target version before scheduling a differential; mark unsupported route cells NOT_APPLICABLE and continue via another eligible evidence path.

Treat same-library re-open and file-size/entity-count similarity as insufficient for application-visible graph fidelity; use one composed checkpoint rather than adding routine peer builds or full suites.
Correct the 7AI summary row to show XRECORD payload-slot work committed in the worktree while keeping 7G root expansion separate.
Record that the historical PAR-139.1/.2 GEODATA red status is superseded by the existing newline-escape implementation and passing focused/owning gates.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
limitations: ACadSharp discussion #479 is an older, unpinned peer report and was not reproduced; it cannot establish current peer behavior or a libdxfrw defect.
Project documentation describes declared project scope, not independent semantic correctness or broad per-entity interoperability.
No peer executable, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was run; no external drawing or fixture was downloaded.
No code, tests, fixtures, dependencies, or support metadata were changed.
